Technology Careers.title: Software Engineer
Technology Careers.description: Responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining software applications.
Technology Careers.education: Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience with a strong project portfolio.

Technology Careers.title: Data Scientist
Technology Careers.description: Responsible for analyzing and interpreting complex data to help drive business decisions.
Technology Careers.education: Bachelor's degree in statistics, mathematics, computer science, or a related field; many roles prefer a master's.

Technology Careers.title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
Technology Careers.description: Responsible for developing and implementing AI algorithms and models.
Technology Careers.education: Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or machine learning, plus strong programming skills.

Technology Careers.title: UX Designer
Technology Careers.description: Responsible for creating intuitive and engaging user experiences.
Technology Careers.education: Bachelor's degree in design or human-computer interaction, or a strong portfolio of user research and design work.

Medicine Careers.title: Doctor
Medicine Careers.description: Responsible for diagnosing and treating patients.
Medicine Careers.education: Bachelor's degree, medical school (MD or DO), residency training, and state licensure.

Medicine Careers.title: Nurse
Medicine Careers.description: Responsible for providing direct patient care and support.
Medicine Careers.education: Nursing diploma, associate, or bachelor's degree (BSN), plus national licensure exam.

Medicine Careers.title: Psychologist
Medicine Careers.description: Responsible for studying and treating mental health conditions.
Medicine Careers.education: Doctoral degree (PhD or PsyD) in psychology and state licensure.

Creative Arts Careers.title: Graphic Designer
Creative Arts Careers.description: Responsible for creating visual concepts and designs for various media.
Creative Arts Careers.education: Bachelor's degree in graphic design or a related field, or a strong portfolio.

Creative Arts Careers.title: Writer
Creative Arts Careers.description: Responsible for creating written content for various platforms.
Creative Arts Careers.education: A strong writing portfolio; many writers study English, journalism, or a related field.

Environment & Science Careers.title: Environmental Scientist
Environment & Science Careers.description: Studies air, water, soil, and ecosystems to understand pollution and recommend ways to protect natural resources.
Environment & Science Careers.education: Bachelor's degree in environmental science, biology, chemistry, or a related field; graduate study is common for research roles.

Engineering & Trades Careers.title: Civil Engineer
Engineering & Trades Careers.description: Plans, designs, and oversees roads, water systems, and buildings that communities rely on.
Engineering & Trades Careers.education: Bachelor's degree in civil engineering, followed by supervised experience and a professional license.

Education Careers.title: Teacher
Education Careers.description: Plans lessons and supports students so they can learn, grow, and build confidence.
Education Careers.education: Bachelor's degree and a teaching certificate; requirements vary by state.
